svg.title: Chengyu of the day: 画蛇添足 (traditional 畫蛇添足), huà shé tiān zú, “Draw a snake, add feet”. The abstraction nobody asked for. Ship the snake. The characters write themselves in stroke by stroke, in Simplified and then in Traditional.

g.text: The abstraction nobody asked for. Ship the snake.
in real stroke order · a new one every day
